instance_description:
Setting: During 2026, this instance covers a nonprofit culinary institute’s professional baking-and-pastry certificate, taught through classrooms, production kitchens, tasting panels, and sanitation workshops.
Scope: Recurring areas include recipe theory, mise en place planning, skills labs, ingredient costing, sanitation compliance, practical exams, critique reflection, portfolio bakes, advising, and education expenses.
Resources: Reusable records track learner-owned items, scheduled kitchen activities, and competency requirements; blank files support lab notes, recipe costing drafts, and program communications; a personal wallet handles authorized costs.
Exclusions: It excludes paid bakery work, restaurant operations, official institute systems, instructor grading authority, classmates’ private data, and unsupervised hazardous equipment use.
personal_description:
Identity: Saanvi Mireille Okafor is an adult learner enrolled throughout 2026 in a structured professional baking-and-pastry certificate at a nonprofit culinary institute.
Responsibilities: She manages weekly preparation, recipe calculations, production-kitchen readiness, sanitation documentation, technique practice, critique follow-up, portfolio evidence, advising steps, and personal education spending.
Authority: Saanvi may organize her own learning records, draft assignments and messages, request permitted student support, purchase approved supplies, and track progress against published competencies.
Restrictions: She cannot alter official grades, certify food-safety completion, authorize classmates’ work, access restricted kitchen records, override instructor safety rules, or sell certificate lab products as personal goods.
